classes.purpose: Carry out mix-contribution-analysis using the selected evidence and user instructions
classes.content: Selected sales or revenue rows, category and member labels, periods, measures, recipe mappings, calculated shares and contributions, complete source tables, chart context and images, retained diagnostics and interpretation. Local numerical/rendering code makes no separate model call. Reading original data or outputs adds those actual values to host context; no automatic anonymization is applied. Any separately requested publication uses the parent reporting route.
